business_problem: The biggest challenge that PwC’s customers are facing right now is having access to complete, accurate, reliable sustainability data. PwC solutions are built on secure Microsoft technology to help its clients deliver sustainable growth, agility, and lasting innovation.
solution_summary: PwC built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft Sustainability Manager. The biggest challenge that PwC’s customers are facing right now is having access to complete, accurate, reliable sustainability data. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. Power Platform provides the governed low-code foundation for apps, automations, and copilots. Dynamics 365 provides the core business application experience for service, sales, or operations workflows. Microsoft Sustainability Manager collects, models, and reports sustainability data for compliance and planning.
